description: Call before issuing an invoice, processing a cross-border payment, or storing a counterparty's VAT number. Validate a VAT registration number against the official EU VIES service (or HMRC for GB). Returns validity status, registered name, and registered address.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, UPPERCASE. Use GB for the United Kingdom (HMRC), not UK. Supports all EU member states plus GB and NO.

vat_number.description: VAT number WITHOUT country prefix — just the digits/characters. Example: for DK29403473, pass '29403473'.

name: validate_vat

address.description: Registered address. null when not disclosed by the member state.

name.description: Registered company name. null when the member state does not disclose trader details via VIES (e.g. DE, ES) — the number can still be valid.

valid.description: True if VIES / HMRC confirms the number is registered and active.

vatNumber.description: Full VAT number including country prefix, e.g. DE143454214.
